experiment.fall_definition: pelvis height <0.45m OR pelvis up-axis cosine <0.5; trial then stops
limitations: Initial-condition trials of one published policy, not independently trained seeds.
Foot-contact telemetry supports visual gait inspection; absence of slipping is not established.
A finite flat-ground rollout is not a stability proof or evidence of hardware safety.
This baseline evaluation makes no policy-training or sim-to-real claim.
experiment.seed_definition: seed 0 canonical; others mt19937_64 uniform +/-0.005 rad initial leg-joint noise; exact vector recorded
experiment.step_definition: foot-floor touchdown after >=60ms absence; simultaneous landings do not alternate
experiment.success_criteria: full duration without fall; distance >=50% commanded; >=5 touchdowns per foot; >=8 alternations; <=10% airborne samples
experiment.zero_baseline: All 12 motor torques zero; no PD, policy, or external support

provenance.asset_manifest_scope: config, policy, and every XML/STL/OBJ in the G1 model resource directory
provenance.model_limitations: 12 actuated leg joints; upper-body joints are fixed; level ground only
provenance.policy_training: Published Unitree policy; not trained by this project

applied_action_diagnostics.scope: One sample per joint per applied PD control interval since reset; zero-torque control excluded

results.height_reference: pelvis floating-base origin above z=0 ground
